about: Aggregate sleep norms by age from the Liu et al. (2019) infant-sleep dataset (Baby Connect app users, logged by parents). Minutes, except naps (count) and bedtime/wake (minutes after local midnight of the day; above 1440 = after midnight). Percentiles P10, P25, P50, P75, P90 across infants. No per-infant data.

source.title: Time-Series Analysis via Low-Rank Matrix Factorization Applied to Infant-Sleep Data (Liu S, et al. NeurIPS 2019 Machine Learning for Health workshop)
